page.overview:
Who is Equivalent to Tai Sui?

The is a demon who kidnapped the queen of Scarlet-Purple Kingdom. He turned out to be the belonging to the Bodhisattva Guanyin.

The Equivalent to Tai Sui has pointed teeth, tousled red locks that flared upwards, arrow-like whiskers, and long hair that wraps over his body. Coloured clouds soar up from his head and violent gusts of air burst from his chest,

After killing two peacocks who were children of the Bodhisattva Mahamayuri, the king of Scarlet-Purple Kingdom was ordained to spend three years heartbroken. The Golden-Haired Hou accompanied Guanyin at the meeting where this was decreed and decided to exact the punishment himself.

Becoming the Equivalent to Tai Sui, they went down to the Scarlet-Purple Kingdom and demanded the king's favourite wife be given to them. The kingdom was powerless to resist, so reluctantly gave the queen over to him.
